story: Discover the stunning Tawny Eagle (*Aquila rapax*), a member of the diverse Accipitridae family. Native to Arid/semi-arid habitats: deserts; steppes; open savannah; grassland; and dry woodland, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Vulnerable (VU) on the IUCN Red List, the Tawny Eagle represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
